#!/usr/bin/python
from __future__ import print_function
import grp
import os
import socket

base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
path = os.path.join(base, 'run/status.sock')
status_path = os.path.join(base, 'status.txt')

if os.path.lexists(path):
    os.unlink(path)

server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
server.bind(path)
os.chown(path, -1, grp.getgrnam('status-readers').gr_gid)
os.chmod(path, 0o660)
server.listen(5)

while True:
    client, unused_address = server.accept()
    try:
        request = b''
        while b'\n' not in request and len(request) <= 4096:
            chunk = client.recv(1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            request += chunk
        if request == b'STATUS\n':
            with open(status_path, 'rb') as status_file:
                client.sendall(status_file.read())
        else:
            client.sendall(b'ERROR\n')
    finally:
        client.close()
PYEOF
sudo chown root:root "$BASE/server.py"
sudo chmod 0755 "$BASE/server.py"
sudo chown root:statusd "$BASE/status.txt"
sudo chmod 0640 "$BASE/status.txt"
sudo chown statusd:status-readers "$BASE/run"
sudo chmod 0750 "$BASE/run"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$BASE/status.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ]
printf 'status_sha256_before=%s\nstatus_sha256_after=%s\n' "$BEFORE" "$AFTER"
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' "$BASE/server.py" "$BASE/status.txt" "$BASE/run"
